sentences.l2: 每逢选举季，媒体公布民调结果时，总会附上一行小字：“误差范围为正负三个百分点。”
sentences.l1: Every election season, when the media publish poll results, they always attach a line of small print: "The margin of error is plus or minus three percentage points."

sentences.l2: 这并非套话，而是置信区间的通俗说法。
sentences.l1: This is not a stock phrase, but a popular way of saying confidence interval.

sentences.l2: 民调机构不可能询问每一位选民，只能随机抽取约一千名受访者，再据此估计全体选民的态度。
sentences.l1: Polling organizations cannot ask every voter, and can only randomly select about one thousand respondents, then estimate the attitudes of all voters from them.

sentences.l2: 样本只是总体的一小部分，估计值难免有偏差，所以要给出一个区间，而不是单一数字。
sentences.l1: A sample is only a small part of the population, and the estimate inevitably has some deviation, so an interval has to be given rather than a single number.

sentences.l2: 例如，某候选人支持率为百分之五十，误差范围为正负三个百分点，意味着真实支持率大致在百分之四十七到五十三之间。
sentences.l1: For example, if a candidate's support rate is fifty percent and the margin of error is plus or minus three percentage points, it means the true support rate is roughly between forty-seven and fifty-three percent.

sentences.l2: 这个判断还取决于置信水平，通常设为百分之九十五，即同样的调查重复一百次，约有九十五次得到的区间会涵盖真实数值。
sentences.l1: This judgment also depends on the confidence level, which is usually set at ninety-five percent, that is, if the same survey is repeated one hundred times, about ninety-five of the intervals obtained will cover the true value.

sentences.l2: 之所以常见“三个点”，是因为样本量约一千时，误差恰好接近这个数；若想让误差减半，样本量须扩大到四倍，成本会急剧上升，因此多数机构选择折中。
sentences.l1: The reason "three points" is commonly seen is that when the sample size is about one thousand, the error happens to be close to this figure; if one wants to halve the error, the sample size must be expanded to four times, and the cost rises sharply, so most organizations choose a compromise.
